M_Wonder_LightShaft.note: additive translucent; opacity = vertex colour Fade x view-facing falloff

conventions.units: 1 Blender unit = 1 m; Z up; front faces -Y; FBX exported with the standard axis settings
conventions.atlas: each slot texture is a 2048x2048 atlas of four 2048x512 bands (band k = UV v in [k/4,(k+1)/4]); u tiles (UVs run past 0..1 in u by design), v stays inside one band; band k covers U x V metres as listed per material. Use Wrap addressing.
conventions.normal: tangent space, OpenGL (+Y up): flip green on import into Unreal
conventions.emissive: Emissive = M.R * lerp(EmissiveA, EmissiveB, M.G) * (EmissiveDay or EmissiveNight by sun)
conventions.culture: BaseColor = D * lerp(BaseTint, AccentTint, M.B); Roughness = ORM.G * RoughnessScale
